context: Daichi and Tatsuya plan a country project.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: たつや、新しいプロジェクト、本当、考えてる。
lines.en: Tatsuya, I've been thinking about this new project. Seriously.
lines.style: Kansai lilt on the opening word. Warm, eager energy. Leans forward slightly. The brightness of genuine excitement, not performing—real sincerity underneath the regional swing.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.en: Yeah, let's talk about it properly.
lines.style: Slow, steady acceptance. Rural composure in the pacing. Eyes land on Daichi with quiet recognition. Warmth that doesn't rush—patient, genuinely present.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: I want to bring the vitality back to the town. Really.
lines.style: Energy peaks on the commitment. Kansai swing carries the conviction. Earnest now—not just excited, but sincere about what matters. Soft intensity.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Quiet promise in the tone. Slow, unhurried. Settles into the moment. The tenderness of someone who means what he says without needing to prove it.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Everyone will support it. I'm sure of that.
lines.style: Conviction rings clear. Kansai brightness carries the confidence. Generous—looking outward, not inward. Soft warmth on the certainty, not arrogance.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Voice quiets with genuine gratitude. Deep, unhurried. The repetition lands gently—not emphasis, just the weight of real feeling. Rural composure holds the tenderness.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: これからも、頑張ろうな、本当に。
lines.en: From here on, we'll keep going. I promise.
lines.style: Softer now—the energy pulls inward, becomes a vow. Kansai warmth wraps the words. Genuine promise at the end: steady, not shouty. Tender underneath.
